about_description: BF SecureLens is engineered by BF Team. Our mission is to empower software developers, security analysts, and enterprise engineers with instant, privacy-focused security auditing tools to identify code vulnerabilities and remediate security gaps.
mission_desc: Provide developer-friendly static security analysis tools that run 100% offline, protecting your intellectual property while enforcing robust OWASP & NIST security standards.
contact_subtitle: Have questions, feedback, or need custom security auditing tools? Contact BF Team support team.
privacy_subtitle: We prioritize your code privacy. Read about our zero-data collection guarantee.
privacy_section_1_desc: BF SecureLens performs all static analysis, regex secret scanning, and manifest checks strictly on your local machine. Your source code files, configurations, and scan results are NEVER uploaded to remote servers or cloud services.
privacy_section_2_desc: We do not track, collect, store, or transmit telemetry, user data, file paths, or vulnerability metrics. Your intellectual property remains exclusively within your local workspace environment.
privacy_section_3_desc: Exported PDF, Markdown, and JSON audit reports are saved directly to your local file system. No report data leaves your device.
